entry.author: Interislander
entry.summary:
Interislander links the islands for Te Araroa walkers.

Becoming a sponsor of the Te Araroa Trail was a natural step for Interislander. This new partnership reinforces our commitment to connecting travellers across Cook Strait between the North and South Islandes of New Zealand and celebrating outstanding Kiwi experiences.

Registered Te Araroa walkers receive a discount on ferry fares for The Interislander Connection. 

www.interislander.co.nz/teararoa
